contradictions.description: The 2026-06-30 AP aging totals $25,323.00, while the trial balance reports Accounts Payable of $53,475.24. The $28,152.24 difference is the unpaid remainder of opening AP ($56,304.47 less the $28,152.23 payment), but it is omitted from the AP aging.

w08-accrual_schedule.reason: The May prepaid schedule, insurance policy, software contract, and June GL postings uniquely establish opening balances, additions, amortization, closing balances, and the status of the supporting amortization entry.

w08-bank_rec.reason: The bank statement, cash ledger, trial balance, and BILL-3127 source document provide enough information to identify clearing items, unrecorded bank activity, and the $360 cash-recording error and to derive a unique adjusted cash balance.

w08-journal_entries.reason: The payroll register, prepaid records, fixed-asset register, ledger, and available authoritative vendor bills identify the required payroll accrual, missing depreciation, and vendor-expense reclassification without duplicating posted entries.

w08-variance_analysis.reason: June ledger activity, budgets, and the close-supporting records are sufficient to calculate as-closed actuals and provide support for the material variances using ordinary professional materiality judgment.
